summary: Frontend-only UI-truth verification for SIP status pills, sidebar SIP Settings entry, and Settings save/connect flow against real WebRTC extension 568244@webdialer.depthroute.com. All 7 requested checks PASSED. Header pill and sidebar user block correctly reflect useSipEngine().status (no longer hardcoded 'SIP Registered'). Sidebar SUPPORT section contains 'SIP Settings' (testID='sidebar-item-settings') and navigates to /settings. Load Demo populates the exact expected credentials. Save & Connect reaches the server: SIP Log shows Connecting → SIP UA started → WebSocket connected → Registration failed: Authentication Error (401), which is the EXPECTED server-side outcome per the request. Registration Status card shows red 'Registration Failed' with sub-line '568244@webdialer.depthroute.com'. Header pill transitions to 'Reg. Failed' (red) on Dashboard and sidebar user block shows 'Registration Failed'. Regression spot-check on /dialer, /contacts, /call-logs — all load with header. No red screens or crashes.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.tsx, Sidebar.tsx and dashboard.tsx all derive SIP label from useSipEngine().status — good, no hardcoding remaining.

SipEngineProvider auto-connects on config change and on every full page reload; observed reconnect cycle on each page.goto during regression testing (harmless in real in-app navigation via Expo Router).
Password field renders bullets in DOM but underlying input.value correctly holds '123456' after Load Demo — verified via el.value read.

Console warnings observed (non-blocking): 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported' on web preview — cosmetic only, no impact on flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testID is 'login-submit-button' (not 'login-submit'). SIP engine autoconnects when config is present; SIP Log successfully shows Auth 401 from wss://webdialer.depthroute.com:8089/ws confirming transport is live. Header pill testID='header-sip-pill' is hidden on Settings screen (showSip={false}); verify pill on /dashboard or other main screens.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — this iteration was a verification of already-applied UI-truth fixes. All behavior matches the intent: hardcoded 'SIP Registered' labels have been replaced with engine.status-driven labels; a new 'SIP Settings' sidebar entry (SUPPORT section) navigates to /settings; DEFAULT_SIP_CONFIG reflects 568244/123456 on webdialer.depthroute.com; Save & Connect reaches the server (WebSocket connected) and the server returns SIP 401 Authentication Error as expected (server-side provisioning outside app scope).
